def solution():
    # Define variables
    claim_amounts = [150000]
    claim_paid_dates = ["year_end"]
    claim_settlement_expenses = [30000]
    reinsurance_paid_claims = [70000]
    reinsurance_paid_expenses = [10000]
    discount_rate = 0.05

    # Calculate net liabilities after reinsurance
    net_claims = sum(
        claim_amounts[i] - reinsurance_paid_claims[i]
        for i in range(len(claim_amounts))
    )
    net_expenses = sum(
        claim_settlement_expenses[i] - reinsurance_paid_expenses[i]
        for i in range(len(claim_settlement_expenses))
    )

    total_net_liabilities = net_claims + net_expenses

    # Discount the reserve for one future period
    ibnr_reserve = total_net_liabilities / ((1 + discount_rate) ** len(claim_amounts))

    # Return the reserve rounded to the nearest dollar
    return round(ibnr_reserve)
